abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. WHILE_STATIC is re-evaluated on every attack-power recalculation. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines it to this card's own attack. The condition also asked COUNTER_GTE 'power' -- a POWER COUNTER count, not the card's {p}. 'If this has 6 or more {p}' is the attack's power, which is what the red printing already used.
